news.title: SkillOpt: Agent skills as trainable parameters
news.summary_raw:

news.summary: Microsoft Research's SkillOpt turns skill editing for AI agents into a trainable process, making their behavior more reliable without modifying model weights. This development allows for more effective training of AI agents' skills without changing their underlying architecture.

news.summary: Microsoft Research has developed Memora, a scalable memory system for AI agents to retain context across conversations. This aims to improve efficiency in tasks that require recalling previous interactions.
